topics.headline: Eurozone HICP already confirmed higher; US CPI rebound highly likely too
topics.summary: Eurostat's flash estimate shows eurozone inflation accelerated to 2.9% in July from 2.8%, driven by a jump in energy prices, while surging oil and gasoline costs, a 96-cent Kalshi price on a positive core CPI print, and consensus forecaster views all point to a US CPI rebound after June's energy-driven dip. Both conditions look on track to be met, though the official US July CPI release on August 12 remains the key confirming data point.

topics.headline: HY spreads near cycle tights, but risks tilt toward widening
topics.summary: The BofA HY OAS sits at 2.87 (near multi-year tights vs. a 4.9% historical average), with this week's modest widening driven by a rate selloff amid oil/Iran tensions rather than credit deterioration. Fed held rates steady with a data-dependent stance, and strong issuance/ETF demand offsets bearish flags from PineBridge and Man Group about 2026 supply-driven widening risk.
